registry_date_HE: 12026年7月19日（人类纪元；对应公元2026年7月19日）
purpose: Canonical registry of applicable copyright legal-regime scopes for Q33 rights governance and external-input rights review. It models the territorial scope of application of each legal regime (legal_regime_scope / territorial_law_scope). This registry makes NO assertion of sovereignty or political status (sovereignty_position: NOT_ASSERTED for every entry). Rules are sourced from official legislative databases, WIPO Lex, EUR-Lex, and official platform policy pages.
rule_authority_principle: Only official, original, current-source rules are authoritative. Blogs, search summaries, old lab content, and model memory are NOT rule authority.
fallback_principle: When rule currentness cannot be confirmed, official source is inaccessible, jurisdiction conflicts exist, or facts are insufficient: register as UNVERIFIED, COUNSEL_REQUIRED, PERMISSION_REQUIRED, INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION, or BLOCKED_PENDING_EVIDENCE.

Berne_Convention_1886.title: Berne Convention for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works (Stockholm Act 1967)
key_principles: Minimum term: life of author + 50 years (Art. 7)
Berne_Convention_1886.notes: Universal baseline; all surveyed jurisdictions are signatories.

WCT_1996.title: WIPO Copyright Treaty (1996) — digital environment special agreement under Berne
key_principles: Computer programs protected as literary works (Art. 4)
Rights of reproduction, distribution, rental, communication to the public (Art. 6-8)

TRIPS_Copyright.title: Agreement on Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights — Part II: Copyright and Related Rights
key_principles: Berne Articles 1-21 apply via TRIPS Art. 9(1)
Protection extends to expressions not ideas/procedures/methods (Art. 9(2))
Three-step test codified: limited exceptions, no conflict with normal exploitation, no unreasonable prejudice to legitimate interests

GitHub_DMCA_Takedown_Policy.title: GitHub DMCA Takedown Policy
key_rules: DMCA requires a valid takedown notice with specific elements: identification of copyrighted work, identification of infringing material, contact info, good faith belief statement, accuracy under penalty of perjury, signature
Counter-notification rights: alleged infringer may submit counter-notification with consent to jurisdiction
Restoration after 10-14 business days if no lawsuit filed
Repository may be disabled after multiple violations

GitHub_DMCA_Guide.title: Guide to Submitting a DMCA Takedown Notice
key_rules: Notice must include all elements specified in 17 U.S.C. § 512(c)(3)

GitHub_dmca_repository.title: github/dmca — Repository with text of DMCA takedown notices as received
GitHub_dmca_repository.note: GitHub publishes received takedown notices publicly; does not endorse assertions in notices

summary.modeling_note: total_jurisdictions counts distinct applicable legal-regime scopes modeled for technical rights-governance; it is NOT a count of sovereign states. Every entry carries sovereignty_position: NOT_ASSERTED.

sovereignty_statement: This registry models the applicable copyright legal regimes and their territorial scopes of application for technical rights-governance only. It does NOT assert, recognize, or deny the sovereignty, independence, or political status of any territory or government. Every entry carries sovereignty_position: NOT_ASSERTED.
